A '''mammalian species''' was one of the many [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==Biology and appearance==
This species was distinguished by their gray fur which coated their entire bodies except for their faces and underbellies, which was lighter in color. They also possessed long tails which had a fin-like shape at the end. They had long pointed ears and fingers tipped with with gray claws.<ref name="AoSW">''[[The Art of Star Wars Episode I: The Phantom Menace]]''</ref><ref name="WoSW">''[[The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide]]''</ref>

The known members of the species seen in the galaxy were not known to wear substantial clothing. However, they did wear elaborate jewelry, which included earrings and large headdresses which tied their hair into a sloping position which ran off the back of their heads. Additionally, they were seen wearing belts which ran around their waists and were woven into the base of their tails. At least one member of the species wore a bikini top while in the service of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]].<ref name="AoSW" /><ref name="WoSW" />

==Presence in the galaxy==
[[File:HuttParty.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Members of the species serve the Hutts by providing food and fanning their masters.]]

Members of the species were seen working for the Hutts during the time of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. They provided food for their masters and were seen fanning patrons of the Hutts' court. At least one member of the species was used as a [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] girl and was part of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure's]] harem.<ref name="AoSW" />

Two members of the species participated in a circus troope that toured [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], juggling and dancing with a [[Zalaaca/Legends|zalaaca]].<ref name="WoSW" />

After the fall of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] and the rise of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], [[Unidentified New Republic mammalian diplomat|one female member]] of the species represented her people as a [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomat]] on the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. She was seen with several other senators, including a [[Unidentified New Republic Dug diplomat|Dug]] and a [[Unidentified New Republic Twi'lek diplomat|Twi'lek]] who all owned [[saw-toothed grank]]s.<ref name="WoSW" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:New_Republic_Senator.jpg|thumb|right|200px|A member of this species with their favorite pet.]]
This species has not been named [[canon]]ically. It first appeared in ''[[The Art of Star Wars Episode I: The Phantom Menace]]'' in [[1999]] drawn by artist [[Terryl Whitlatch]]. Drawn as a concept for a potential species in [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], they were designed as servants for the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]]. However, the design was not approved for inclusion in the film, and the species did not appear in ''The Phantom Menace''. The second appearance of the species was in ''[[The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide]]'' in [[2001]], also drawn by Terryl Whitlatch, appearing in a list of senators with their favorite pets, in addition to in a circus troope.
